spread: embedded in assumed ask/bid execution prices; extra slippage charged once separately
filters: assumed bid <= ask for each product
exclude every conflicting duplicate timestamp; collapse exact duplicates with provenance
observed logger clock09:00..15:30, prior reference-expiry safety filter retained
continuity: Entry and fill still require60s; held exit condition evaluated also on first next-day quote after approved carry
censor_policy: Only non-approved missing data or reference change censors an open position; approved normal closure retains it; no forced liquidation
annual_chain: One account stops at first open risk boundary; subsequent independent chains never summed as annual return
auxiliary_segments: Independent chains now join approved normal closures; reference cash 30m separately disclosed
borrowing: reverse-direction theoretical; availability and borrowing fees unverified, not certified zero
order_window: 09:00..15:30 observed logs only; all orders disabled outside window; holdings retained
contract_hypothesis: Log quotes assumed to be official reference contract, actual identity unconfirmed
overnight: Carry only rechecked 199 candidate closures; no nighttime marks or orders, no fabricated settlement
pending_at_close: Cancel unfilled pending orders across closure; reevaluate exit at next observed open; fill only next contiguous quote
risk_boundaries: Intraday missing, reference contract change, skipped official trading date, missing 09:00/15:30 logger edge censor open positions
quarter_boundaries: Preserve position and all cash state, never censor or reset merely due month/quarter
